native_test_entries: test1: {'pot1': 'high', 'pot2': 'low', 'rgb1': 'yellow', 'rgb2': 'red', 'description': 'Potentiometer 1 is set to high (1) and potentiometer 2 is set to low (0). RGB LED 1 should display yellow (RGB approximately [1,1,0]), and RGB LED 2 should display red (RGB approximately [1,0,0]).'}

test2: {'pot1': 'high', 'pot2': 'high', 'rgb1': 'yellow', 'rgb2': 'yellow', 'description': 'Both potentiometers are set to high (1). RGB LED 1 should display yellow (RGB approximately [1,1,0]), and RGB LED 2 should also display yellow (RGB approximately [1,1,0]).'}

test3: {'pot1': 'low', 'pot2': 'high', 'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'yellow', 'description': 'Potentiometer 1 is set to low (0) and potentiometer 2 is set to high (1). RGB LED 1 should display red (RGB approximately [1,0,0]), and RGB LED 2 should display yellow (RGB approximately [1,1,0]).'}

test4: {'pot1': 'low', 'pot2': 'low', 'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'red', 'description': 'Both potentiometers are set to low (0). RGB LED 1 should display red (RGB approximately [1,0,0]), and RGB LED 2 should also display red (RGB approximately [1,0,0]).'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
